title: Spinnet Plugin View
description: The view a script answers with as `{view, state}`, as of Plugin API Level 1 (ADR 0010). The Host draws a title, the Plugin's own setting controls, a Form, a Detail and Actions, in that order, and never the Plugin's own markup. `spinnet.ui` builds each part. Besides the shapes below, the Host checks that field keys, section IDs, action IDs and shortcuts are each distinct, that a setting control names one of the Plugin's own `choice` or `toggle` settings, each once, that a shortcut includes cmd or ctrl, names each modifier once and is not one the view keeps (cmd+w, cmd+q, cmd+c, cmd+v, cmd+x, cmd+a, cmd+z, cmd+shift+z, cmd+return), that inserted text is at most 128 KiB, and that the whole description is at most 256 KiB of JSON. A view that breaks any of these ends the View Session as a protocol violation.

text.description: A string with at least one character that is not white space.

identifier.description: A field key, section ID or action ID: not blank, at most 64 characters.

allOf.description: A view has at least one of form, detail and actions.

setting_control.description: A control for one of the Plugin's own choice or toggle settings. The Host shows what is stored, stores a change as Plugin Settings are, and then delivers setting_changed; the Action does not run again.

form.description: Fields whose values arrive with field_changed and submitted.

field.description: A field of one of the kinds Plugin Settings use whose value is text, a switch, or one choice. Without a value it starts empty, off, or on its first choice.

allOf.description: Only a choice has choices, and a choice's value is one of them; choice_titles give one title per choice.

section.description: A Detail section. Without fetch it shows text in the Markdown subset: **bold** or __bold__, *italic* or _italic_, `inline code`, ``` fenced code blocks ```, and [links](https://example.com) to http or https pages, which open under the open_url rules. Anything else shows as plain text. With fetch it is a Host-Fetched Section: the Host sends its request and shows the answer.

fetch.description: A Host-Fetched Section's request, specified by host-fetched-section.schema.json. A malformed fetch fails only its own section.

shortcut.description: Modifiers from cmd, ctrl, option and shift, joined by +, then a lowercase letter, a digit, or return, such as cmd+shift+k.

action.description: A button, with an optional shortcut. With id it delivers action_chosen; with perform it is a standard action the Host performs itself, without a View Event, under the Capability its Host Service needs: copy_text (write_clipboard), open_url (open_url), insert_text (insert_into_focused_app, into the App the view came from) and open_plugin_settings (none). A refusal shows in the view with its repair route. closes_view closes the view once a standard action succeeds.
